elements.description: The files, code and documents a run produced: a list, a preview per type, versions with a diff, download.

properties.name: selected
properties.description: The id of the artifact shown; empty shows the first. Changed by the user unless a tc-selected-change listener calls preventDefault()

properties.name: version
properties.description: The id of the version shown; empty shows the latest. Changed by the user unless a tc-version-change listener calls preventDefault()

properties.name: view
properties.description: "preview", or "diff" to compare the version with the one before. Changed by the user unless a tc-view-change listener calls preventDefault()

properties.name: heading
properties.description: The heading, and the region's name

properties.name: emptyLabel
properties.description: Shown when there is nothing yet

properties.name: previewHeight
properties.description: The preview's height cap in px; longer content scrolls

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-selected-change
events.description: An artifact was picked in the list ({ id, selected }: ArtifactSelectedChange – both the artifact's id); cancelable

events.name: tc-version-change
events.description: A version was picked, or picking another artifact went back to its latest ({ artifact: string, version: string }); cancelable

events.name: tc-view-change
events.description: Compare was turned on or off ({ view: "preview" | "diff" }); cancelable

events.name: tc-download
events.description: Download was pressed ({ artifact: Artifact, version: ArtifactVersion }); cancelable – unless prevented, the element saves the file

functions.name: artifactTableToCsv
functions.description: A table as CSV text, with a header row

functions.name: artifactTableFromCsv
functions.description: CSV text (first row: the columns) as a table

functions.name: saveArtifact
functions.description: Saves a version as a file: a Blob for text, code and tables, the image's own URL for images

props.name: title
props.description: The heading, and the region's name

props.name: selected
props.description: The id of the artifact shown (controlled); empty shows the first

props.name: defaultSelected
props.description: The artifact shown first when `selected` isn't given

props.name: onSelectedChange
props.description: Called with the artifact's id when the user picks one in the list

props.name: version
props.description: The id of the version shown (controlled); empty shows the latest

props.name: defaultVersion
props.description: The version shown first when `version` isn't given; empty shows the latest

props.name: onVersionChange
props.description: A version was picked; picking another artifact goes back to its latest ("")

props.name: view
props.description: "preview", or "diff" to compare with the version before (controlled)

props.name: defaultView
props.description: The view to start in when `view` isn't given

props.name: onViewChange
props.description: Called when the user turns Compare on ("diff") or off ("preview")

props.name: onDownload
props.type: (artifact: Artifact, version: ArtifactVersion, event: Event) => void
props.description: Download was pressed. The panel saves the file itself unless you call event.preventDefault()

changelog: **Event details:** four change events gained a field named after the property they change. The existing fields stay. The docs' controlled examples read these names, which the events lacked; the new Angular type check caught it. - `tc-artifact-panel`'s `tc-selected-change`: `selected`. - `tc-email-draft`'s `tc-recipient-change`: `recipient`. - `tc-reliance-gauge`'s `tc-review-level-change`: `reviewLevel`. - `tc-transcript-review`'s `tc-translation-mode-change`: `translationMode`.

`tc-artifact-panel` – what a run produced: a list, a preview per kind (Markdown text, code through `tc-code-block`, images, tables from CSV), versions with a diff against the one before, and download (a Blob by default, cancelable).

features.name: light-dark()
features.why: Every colour token is a light / dark pair; without it no colour token resolves.

features.name: color-mix()
features.why: Tints and washes mixed from the tokens.

features.name: Container size queries
features.why: Components adapt to the width they're given, not the window's.

features.name: inert
features.why: Closed and leaving parts are out of the tab order and hidden from screen readers.

features.name: :has()
features.why: Layout and state that depend on what's inside a part (an icon present, a focused field).

features.name: :is() and :where()
features.why: Every rule is keyed on :where() so the page can override it.

features.name: adoptedStyleSheets
features.without: Each element type's CSS goes into one <style> element in <head> instead – it looks and works the same.

features.name: forced-colors media query
features.without: In a forced-colours mode the browser's own adjustments apply, without the components' fixes.

features.name: overscroll-behavior: contain
features.without: Scrolling past the end of a list carries on scrolling the page.
